# mergegateway_organization_pi_settings (Resource)

Manages the organization's prompt-injection (PI) protection policy, which projects inherit unless they override it with `mergegateway_project_pi_settings`. There is one per organization: creating it replaces the current policy, each setting left out takes its default, and destroying it resets the policy to the defaults (PI off).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Block likely prompt injections in every project that doesn't override the
# policy, and redact flagged responses. Settings left out take their defaults.
resource "mergegateway_organization_pi_settings" "this" {
  pi_mode               = "block"
  pi_block_threshold    = 0.6
  pi_indirect_mode      = "alert"
  pi_output_action      = "redact"
  pi_allowlist_patterns = ["ignore previous formatting"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `pi_allowlist_patterns` (List of String) Patterns for text that is never flagged, kept in the order given. Defaults to none.
- `pi_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 1 score at or above which `block` mode blocks a request. Between 0 and 1. Defaults to `0.57`.
- `pi_fail_closed` (Boolean) Block requests when PI detection fails, instead of letting them through. Defaults to `false`.
- `pi_indirect_mode` (String) Detection of indirect prompt injection in tool results and documents: `off`, `alert` or `block`. Defaults to `off`.
- `pi_input_action` (String) What to do when a request is flagged: `observe`, `redact`, `route`, `block` or `escalate`. Defaults to `block`.
- `pi_log_full_text_on_block` (Boolean) Log the full text of blocked requests. Defaults to `false`.
- `pi_mode` (String) Prompt-injection detection on the request: `off`, `alert` (score but never block) or `block` (block when the score reaches `pi_block_threshold`). Defaults to `off`.
- `pi_output_action` (String) What to do when a response is flagged: `observe`, `redact`, `route`, `block` or `escalate`. Defaults to `redact`.
- `pi_pass_threshold` (Number) The Tier 1 score below which a request passes without further checks. Between 0 and 1. Defaults to `0.3`.
- `pi_safer_vendor_route` (String) The vendor flagged requests are routed to when an action is `route`. Leave it out for none.
- `pi_tier2a_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 2A block threshold. Between 0 and 1. Defaults to `0.6`.
- `pi_tier2b_block_threshold` (Number) The Tier 2B block threshold. Between 0 and 1. Defaults to `0.45`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `organization`: there is one policy per organization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one PI policy per organization, so any ID imports it.
terraform import mergegateway_organization_pi_settings.this organization
```
